host.description: Address of the Syncplay server to connect to.

username.description: User name to use when connecting to the server.

room.description: Default room to join upon connection.

password.description: The password required for the server.

player_path.description: Path to the media player binary.

language.description: Language of Syncplay messages. Valid values: de, en, es, eo, fi, fr, it, pt_PT, pt_BR, tr, ru, zh_CN, ko.

no_store.description: Do not store configuration settings in .syncplay.

force_gui_prompt.description: Force configuration window to appear when Syncplay starts.

no_gui.description: Do not show the graphical user interface.

playlist_file.description: Path to a file containing a playlist (one entry per line).
